references.role: Sole exact design reference, original gargoyle face, armor, proportions, spiral core, castle gauntlets and two articulated blade wings. Reposed to a neutral front A-pose for image-to-3D.

visual_qa.identity: Original horn-crested gargoyle face/violet eyes/fangs, massive forearms, castle-gate gauntlet relief, ivory/navy/brass star armor, spiral violet chest core, navy star tabard and two segmented bladed wings retained.
visual_qa.input_composition: One centered front-facing full-body character in neutral A-pose. Two arms/hands, two separated legs/feet, two attached spread wings. Hands are below the wing tips with visible background gaps. No club/shield/extra subject/text/insets/base.
visual_qa.lighting_and_frame: Plain light neutral gray, matte materials, soft even illumination. All wing tips, head, fingers and feet contained. Subject fills roughly90% of image height, tighter than the recommended70-85%; no crop.
visual_qa.hands: Semi-open chunky articulated hands and thumbs distinguishable. Fingers are partly curved/overlap; not claiming all digits are completely separated.
visual_qa.limits: Single-view preparation only. Wing-back attachment depth and mesh/rig quality require review in Tripo; no model was uploaded/generated.
